title: Bond Market About To Flip: A Major Shakeup Is Coming | Jim Welsh
speaker: Jim Welsh (guest), David Lin (host)

macro_themes.view: A/D line very weak; rarely this weak without a meaningful decline; more downside risk than upside.
Contrarian Economist 'bonds crash' cover signals yields are near a high; expects 10y/30y to decline over 2-3 months, possibly after one more 10y high.
No hike in October (election, spacing hikes); expects a hike in December.
AI spending growth slows next year; adoption lags spending; semis highly cyclical; eventual secular bear market as top-10% spending reverses.
